## Contribute to the Catalog!

[Citizen Archivists](https://www.archives.gov/citizen-archivist) can transcribe, tag and comment to enhance discovery of printed and cursive records.

## Access Bulk Data and the API

[The National Archives Catalog API](https://www.archives.gov/research/catalog/help/api)
and dataset provide access to public data and records in a machine readable format.
